effect.name: GM Perspective Curl
effect.desc: Directional page-style perspective curl with cylindrical depth, edge shading and safe source fallback.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm;float c=cos(angle),s=sin(angle);mat2 R=mat2(c,-s,s,c);vec2 p=R*(uv-.5);float x=p.x-pivot+.5;float bend=curl*3.14159265;float theta=x/max(radius,.001)*bend;float curved=sin(theta)*radius/max(abs(bend),.001);float depth=(1.0-cos(theta))*radius;vec2 w=vec2(curved+pivot-.5,p.y/(1.0+depth*perspective));w=mat2(c,s,-s,c)*w+.5;float valid=step(0.0,w.x)*step(w.x,1.0)*step(0.0,w.y)*step(w.y,1.0);vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv),dst=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(w,0.0,1.0));dst.rgb*=1.0-edgeShade*abs(sin(theta));gl_FragColor=mix(src,dst,mixAmount*valid);}
